_comment: Seeded code-intelligence graph. In production this is derived from the repository and generated as a pinned export of the context graph — it is hand-authored here only until that export exists. Paths are repository-relative, matching what `git diff --name-status` emits. `covered_by` names ids from test-scripts/manifest.json and is resolved against it: a script that does not exist is a hard error, because a module claiming coverage it does not have hides the gap. Every entry here previously named a script that did not exist, so the whole regression set resolved to nothing.

modules.coverage_note: no library script covers the status filter yet — reported as a coverage gap on every change that reaches this module
no library script covers the API directly yet — the list script exercises it indirectly, which is not the same claim
